summary: Gulf War Illness (GWI) affects many U.S. Veterans of the 1990-1991 Persian Gulf War (GWVs), yet recognition of the condition and effective treatments remain limited. GWVs with GWI describe feeling dismissed by institutions tasked with their benefits and healthcare, fueling mistrust and disengagement.
